# OpenOntology 0.3.0-alpha.4

This release improves installation guidance, repository organization and the
contributor workflow. The public query operations and stored record formats
are unchanged from alpha.3.

## Changes

- Organize production TypeScript by responsibility, with `.ts` source and ESM
  `.js` output. Build with TypeScript 7 while keeping the Node 24 minimum.
- Show real verification and refusal output in the quickstart. Test the CLI,
  SDK, MCP and source-update examples together.
- Add light and dark README headers and live CI, release and license badges.
- Add formatting and focused rebuild/test commands, including watch mode.
- Generate the source inventory during release instead of requiring contributors
  to update hashes after every edit. Remove frozen version and file-count rules.
- Simplify evidence validation and keep correction eligibility in one place,
  preserving writer refusal, reader quarantine and source verification.

## Install

Requires Node.js 24 or newer:

```bash
npm install https://github.com/Doss-com/openontology/releases/download/v0.3.0-alpha.4/oont-0.3.0-alpha.4.tgz
```

GitHub release assets remain the supported distribution path. The manual npm
publishing workflow requires registry authentication and trusted-publisher setup;
adding that workflow does not publish a package.

## Verify the download

Download `SHA256SUMS` alongside the archive, then run:

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS
gh attestation verify oont-0.3.0-alpha.4.tgz --repo Doss-com/openontology
```

The source inventory is attached separately as `SOURCE-MANIFEST.json`.
For usage and alpha limits, see the [README](https://github.com/Doss-com/openontology#readme).
